name: website-monitor-backend
description: Node.js + Express website uptime and WordPress monitoring SRE backend

scripts.build: node -e "const { execSync, cpSync } = require('child_process'); execSync('npm install', { cwd: '../frontend', stdio: 'inherit' }); execSync('npm run build', { cwd: '../frontend', stdio: 'inherit' }); cpSync('../frontend/build', './src/public', { recursive: true });"
